findings.title: Simulated QRIS Payment Gateway & Non-Functional Production Checkout
findings.evidence: payment-gateway.ts contains Midtrans/Xendit TODO stubs with no webhook endpoint in src/app/api/. wellnessConfirmQrisPayment rejects execution in NODE_ENV===production unless ALLOW_PAYMENT_SIMULATION='true'. QrisCheckoutModal renders a static hardcoded SVG QR graphic and enforces agreedToTerms client-side only.
findings.recommendation: Integrate signed Midtrans/Xendit QRIS gateway + idempotent server webhook verification, render real payment QR payload, and persist termsAgreedAt/termsAgreedVersion inside server payment confirmation.

findings.title: Unauthenticated Static Upload Root & Multi-MB Base64 Photo Storage in PostgreSQL
findings.evidence: POST /api/upload saves body/progress photos directly into unauthenticated public/uploads/workouts/ or returns up to 5MB binary (~6.67MB base64 string) data:image URI when filesystem write fails (e.g. Vercel read-only FS), storing multi-MB text payloads in PostgreSQL TEXT columns with no orphan cleanup on replacement.
findings.recommendation: Migrate media uploads to private object storage (S3/R2/Supabase Storage) with signed upload/read URLs, ownership authorization, and delete-on-replace lifecycle cleanup.

findings.title: Stored XSS Vectors via Unvalidated Photo/Video/Link URLs and Unsanitized href
findings.evidence: Before fix: HealthProfileSchema and SubmitDayProgressSchema allowed arbitrary javascript: URIs; DailyCheckIn (931,947,1293,1338) and AdminClient (6718,11001) rendered raw URLs into href; video-provider used substring hostname checks and unvalidated DIRECT passthrough. Fixed via centralized url-safety helpers, schema refinements, UI href sanitization, and exact video hostname/protocol checks (verified in scripts/test-audit-unit.ts).

findings.title: Placeholder JWT_SECRET in Active .env, Tracked .env.production & Hardcoded Fallbacks
findings.evidence: .env targets remote Supabase Postgres with a placeholder JWT_SECRET string. .env.production is tracked in git (comments only currently, omitted from .gitignore). Dev fallback secrets are hardcoded in middleware.ts, session.ts, and cron route; middleware.ts does not verify tokenVersion or user status (RSC getWellnessSession() enforces both).
findings.recommendation: Rotate JWT_SECRET & CRON_SECRET via platform secret manager, untrack .env.production (git rm --cached) and ignore it, fail closed in production if secrets are unset, and validate active session tokenVersion/status consistently.

findings.title: Free Enrollment paymentReference Unique Constraint Collision
findings.evidence: Before fix: free enrollment created paymentReference using `FREE-${Date.now().toString().slice(-6)}` into a @unique column, wrapping every 1,000 seconds and colliding under concurrent signups (P2002). Fixed in Stage 5 using `crypto.randomBytes(6).toString('hex').toUpperCase()`.

findings.title: In-Memory Rate Limiter Ineffective on Serverless & Keyed Solely by Email
findings.evidence: checkRateLimit relies on a process-local Map() that resets across Vercel cold starts/instances. Sign-in and forgot-password actions key limits strictly by email, enabling multi-account spraying from one IP and targeted lockout of victim emails.
findings.recommendation: Migrate rate limiting to distributed Redis/Upstash with composite IP + email keys.

findings.title: N+1 Query Pattern & Tick Amplification in Notification Dispatch + Unbounded Admin RSC Load
findings.evidence: Every active member tab polls /api/notifications/tick periodically, executing global dispatchDueNotifications across all published programs, days, enrollments, and push subscriptions, running userNotification.findMany inside nested loops. Meanwhile /admin SSR loads up to 200 users with full healthProfile and all dayProgress (potentially multi-MB base64 strings) upfront with silent truncation and no pagination.
findings.recommendation: Move notification dispatch strictly to scheduled server workers/queues with indexed batch queries, and paginate /admin customer queries with explicit media lazy-loading.

findings.title: Service Worker Offline Infinite Reload Loop & Shared Sensitive Media Cache
findings.evidence: Before fix: when navigation exceeded 60ms and failed offline, buildInstantLoadingHtml replaced location with fallbackUrl triggering an infinite navigation reload loop; inflightNavMap/resolvedNavMap lacked eviction; static regex cached /uploads/ images. Fixed in Stage 5 (cache v8, offline:true -> /offline.html, pruneNavMaps(), exclude /uploads/).

findings.title: Client-Only Fake Submission for Report Issue and Quit Program Workflows
findings.evidence: Issue reporting and Quit Program UI forms simulate async success via setTimeout and persist only to browser localStorage (`wellness_quit_requests`, `wellness_reported_issues`) without calling any Server Action or storing to database.
findings.recommendation: Implement authenticated Server Actions and persistent DB tables/tickets for support issues and quit/refund requests.

findings.title: Zero Versioned Prisma Migrations & Unverified Backup / DR Strategy
findings.evidence: prisma/migrations directory does not exist; schema evolution relies on `db push`. Legacy prisma/wellness.db exists in workspace. No backup/PITR verification, restore runbook, or DR drill evidence exists.
findings.recommendation: Initialize baseline versioned Prisma migrations, verify Supabase PITR/backups with periodic restore tests, and prohibit `db push` against production.

findings.title: Dashboard RSC Serializes Future/Un-Enrolled Day Fields & Unvalidated Admin Profile Action
findings.evidence: /dashboard page exposes OPEN status programs (and omits REVIEW from exclusion), and while gating videoUrl/meetupLink, still serializes dayNotifications, videoChecklist, mealRecommendation, dailyAssessment, restInstructions, and eventDetails for locked/un-enrolled days. wellnessAdminUpdateCustomerProfile lacks Zod validation and try/catch.
findings.recommendation: Strip locked/un-enrolled day content completely server-side, align program status filters consistently, and wrap wellnessAdminUpdateCustomerProfile with strict Zod validation + error handling.

findings.title: Monolithic Client Components (AdminClient.tsx 11,720 Lines)
findings.evidence: AdminClient.tsx is 11,720 lines (~582.8 KB), MyPlanTab.tsx 2,495 lines, DailyCheckIn.tsx 2,472 lines, DashboardClient.tsx 1,906 lines, causing tight coupling, high cognitive load, and large client JS payloads (~183-185 kB First Load JS).
findings.recommendation: Decompose monolith components by domain tabs/modals with dynamic imports (`next/dynamic`).

findings.title: Missing Composite Database Indexes, Float Currency Columns & Unconstrained Status Strings
findings.evidence: Missing indexes on ProgramEnrollment.invoiceExpiresAt, UserNotification(userId, createdAt), PasswordResetToken.expiresAt; Program.price and actualPrice use Float rather than Int/Decimal; Program.status uses free-form String with inconsistent variants across files (PUBLISH, PUBLISHED, ACTIVE, OPEN, REVIEW, DRAFT, ARCHIVE).
findings.recommendation: Add targeted indexes, convert currency to Int/Decimal, and standardize Prisma enums via approved migrations.

findings.title: Master Data Cache Sync Misses Multi-Value Programs & Emits Synthetic Fallback IDs
findings.evidence: Master entity rename updates Program string columns via exact equality (`where: { category: oldItem.name }`) without $transaction, skipping comma-separated multi-value strings. wellnessGetMasterData returns synthetic IDs (mc-1, cat-1) if master tables are empty.
findings.recommendation: Perform transactional updates against normalized pivot relations/caches and avoid synthetic IDs in persistence paths.

findings.title: Dashboard Client Posts to Cron Endpoint Without Auth & Embeds Fallback VAPID Key
findings.evidence: DashboardClient embeds a fallback VAPID public key string and invokes POST /api/cron/dispatch-notifications without CRON_SECRET (returning 401 in production).
findings.recommendation: Remove client-side cron trigger and hardcoded fallback VAPID key; configure NEXT_PUBLIC_VAPID_PUBLIC_KEY per environment.

findings.title: Internal Error Details Exposed in API 500 Responses
findings.evidence: Before fix: catch blocks returned raw `error.message` to HTTP callers on 500 errors. Fixed in Stage 5 to return generic 500 messages while logging full errors server-side.

findings.title: Unhandled Promise Rejections in QrisCheckoutModal Actions
findings.evidence: Before fix: handleModeChange and handleRegenerateQris used try/finally without catch blocks. Fixed in Stage 5 by adding explicit catch handlers setting errorMsg.

findings.title: Web Push Sender Invoked Without Configured VAPID Keys Guard
findings.evidence: Before fix: sendWebPushNotification called webpush.sendNotification even when VAPID keys were empty. Fixed in Stage 5 with early return guard.

findings.title: Permissive CSP & Unauthenticated Endpoint Hijack Risk on Push Subscription Upsert
findings.evidence: next.config.mjs CSP allows 'unsafe-inline', 'unsafe-eval', and wildcard https: origins. PushSubscription upsert by endpoint alone can overwrite another user's row if the same endpoint is submitted.
findings.recommendation: Tighten CSP with nonce/strict host allowlists tested against Next.js, and reject or verify ownership when an endpoint belongs to a different userId.

findings.title: Unused Heavy Dependencies (pg, sharp) & LGPL-3.0 / UNKNOWN Transitive Licenses
findings.evidence: pg (^8.23.1) and sharp (^0.35.5) have 0 imports in src/. sharp brings @img/sharp-libvips-* transitive packages (10 LGPL-3.0-or-later, 4 Apache-2.0 AND LGPL-3.0-or-later), and busboy/streamsearch show UNKNOWN licenses in package-lock.json.
findings.recommendation: Remove unused pg/sharp or isolate sharp behind explicit server image pipeline + legal license review.

findings.title: Unoptimized 31.2 MB Landing Video, Global Mobile CSS Override & Unbounded Explore Endpoint
findings.evidence: public/video.mp4 is 31.2 MB loaded on landing hero; globals.css disables backdrop-filter globally on mobile; /api/explore/programs returns up to 100 programs without pagination metadata or HTTP Cache-Control.
findings.recommendation: Compress/stream hero video with poster fallback, scope backdrop-filter optimizations, and add cursor pagination + short CDN caching on /api/explore/programs.

findings.title: No CI/CD Quality Gates, No APM/Alerting, & Non-Isolated Test Script Targeting Live .env DB
findings.evidence: No CI/CD workflows exist; npm test targets whatever DATABASE_URL is in .env (currently remote Supabase Postgres) and writes/deletes records; zero runtime telemetry or alerting.
findings.recommendation: Add GitHub Actions CI (typecheck, lint, unit tests, isolated ephemeral Postgres integration suite) and wire Sentry/structured logging/alerting.

findings.title: Broken Static Cover Asset Reference (/program-cover-cardio.webp 404)
findings.evidence: Before fix: ProfileTab referenced non-existent /program-cover-cardio.webp. Fixed in Stage 5 to existing /image.webp.

findings.title: Outdated SQLite README & Residual Stale Files (prisma/wellness.db, scratch/)
findings.evidence: README still documents SQLite and seeded credentials even though prisma/schema.prisma uses PostgreSQL; stale 540 KB prisma/wellness.db and scratch scripts remain.
findings.recommendation: Update README for PostgreSQL workflows and archive/remove unused scratch/SQLite artifacts upon user approval.

findings.title: Undocumented Admin Mobile Override Parameter & Missing SW Update Prompt
findings.evidence: middleware.ts allows ?forceDesktop=true on admin mobile visits without documentation; ServiceWorkerRegister registers /sw.js silently without notifying users on new SW activation.
findings.recommendation: Add subtle SW update banner and document or remove ?forceDesktop=true.

findings.title: Once-Daily Vercel Hobby Cron Relies on Client Polling for Intraday Notifications
findings.evidence: vercel.json schedules cron once daily (0 0 * * *), forcing intraday alerts to depend on active user browsers calling /api/notifications/tick.
findings.recommendation: Move scheduled cadence dispatch to an external minute/5-minute cron runner or upgraded Vercel Pro cron / queue.

findings.title: Untested Runtime Surfaces: Live SSL/TLS, Load/Stress Tests & Remote DB Integration Suite
findings.evidence: No live staging domain or local test Postgres instance was available, and write tests were intentionally skipped to protect the remote Supabase DB configured in .env.

findings.title: Missing Runtime Telemetry & Offline Vulnerability Database Lookup
findings.evidence: Zero APM/SIEM telemetry exists in app; online CVE lookup (npm audit) was not run in the network-isolated sandbox.
